title: 24x7 Critical & Emergency Care
description: Round-the-clock emergency triage, trauma care, oxygen support, and intensive monitoring.
longDescription: When every second counts, our 24x7 trauma team is on duty with dedicated emergency triage, heated oxygen ICU cages, emergency blood transfusions, and instant point-of-care ultrasound scanning.
features: Continuous oxygen therapy & ICU life support

title: Preventive Care & Vaccination
description: Comprehensive immunization schedules, core vaccines, and seasonal health screenings to protect your pets.
longDescription: Our preventative medicine protocol combines international vaccination standards with thorough physical examinations. We safeguard your pet against rabies, DHPPi, leptospirosis, and kennel cough with gentle administration and minimal stress.

title: Digital Diagnostics & Lab
description: High-definition digital X-rays, ultrasonography, and instant in-house blood biochemistry testing.
longDescription: Our modern laboratory provides clinical answers in minutes. Equipped with high-frequency digital radiography, color Doppler ultrasonography, automated biochemistry, and hematology analyzers.

title: Advanced Veterinary Surgery
description: State-of-the-art sterile surgical suites with dedicated anesthesia monitoring and gentle recovery protocols.
longDescription: From routine spay and neuter procedures to complex soft tissue and orthopedic surgeries, our surgical suites feature laminar airflow sterility, precision multiparameter vitals tracking, and dedicated post-operative warming incubators.
features: Continuous isoflurane gas anesthesia & vitals tracking
Orthopedic repair & soft tissue surgical mastery

title: Dental Prophylaxis & Care
description: Ultrasonic scaling, tooth polishing, and specialized oral treatments for fresh breath and healthy gums.
longDescription: Periodontal disease is the most common condition in adult dogs. Our veterinary dental suite delivers painless ultrasonic subgingival cleaning, enamel polishing, and restorative dental extractions under safe sedation.
features: Digital dental radiography & tooth health scoring

title: Therapeutic & Spa Grooming
description: Medicated baths, breed-specific styling, de-shedding, and hygienic clipping by certified pet stylists.
longDescription: More than just aesthetics, our medical grooming unit specializes in dermatological soothing baths, hygienic ear flushes, breed-tailored clipping, and full fur de-shedding to prevent fungal dermatitis.
features: Gentle ear flushing & paw pad conditioning

title: Luxury Pet Boarding & Daycare
description: Climate-controlled luxury suites, regular exercise sessions, and 24/7 veterinary supervision.
longDescription: Provide your pet with a relaxing vacation while you travel. Our luxury suites feature individual climate control, orthopedic bedding, personalized nutritional schedules, and daily veterinary checkups.
features: Private climate-controlled suites & sanitized play zones
Custom feeding schedules & daily veterinary checkups
Daily video & photo status updates for pet parents
